blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Quezon City’s digital reporting platform, QC iReport has resolved 4,580 of 5,589 reports filed by residents and other users in nearly four months, giving it an 82% resolution rate as of Aug. 31, the city government said. QC iReport, which allows residents to digitally file non-emergency complaints, concerns, requests, and inquiries through QC e-Services and the QCitizen mobile application, posted a 99% response rate during the period, according to the city government.
